i18n.module_banner: i18n is a module (consumed by every gate and platform module); --selftest shows its selftest.
i18n.value_masquerades_contract: pack %(lang)s: value `%(key)s` line %(line)d masquerades as a machine row (%(value)r) — machine contracts must not be translated; reword this message
i18n_cover.filename_has_line_break: a file name in the scan surface contains a line break: %(file)s — once rendered into a message it can forge a machine row (same table as machine.LINE_BREAKS)
